description: Stems hairy or villous. Leaves 5–9-foliolate with smaller leaflets ntermediate. Leaflets sessile, alternate, elliptic or obovate, obtusely serrate, hairy on both surfaces, ± glandular. Petiole slender, villous. Stipules leafy, semi-lunate, toothed. Racemes slender, 10–30cm long. Pedicel short. Bracts 3-fid. Petals yellow. Fruiting calyx hardened, villous, enlarged, grooved, top of the tube with a dense ring of erect and hooked spines.
bibliographicCitation: Agrimonia nepalensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 63. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, 10–15(–30) m. trunk 20–40(–70) cm diam.; bark rough, dark grey to brown. Branchlets with sparse oblong lenticles. Leaves of a bitter and astringent taste, oblong-to ovate-elliptic, apex mostly shortly acutely acuminate, rarely obtuse, base often unequal, acute or unilaterally obtuse-rounded, thin-coriaceous, brownish-blackish in the dry state, with minute ± appressed and crisped yellowish hairs on upper surface of midrib, as on petioles and inflorescences, otherwise glabrous, (5–)6–13 by (2.5–)3–6 cm, nerves 6–10 spreading paris; petiole 1–2 cm. Corymbs many-flowered, 3–8 cm incl. the 1–3 cm long peduncle, their branches in a ± right angle. Petals oblong white to yellowish, fragrant, 5–6 mm. Filaments 1.5 mm. Anthers 3.5 mm. Ovary narrow-ovoid, densely to laxly pubescent; style 2.5 mm. Drupe obliquely ellipsoid, compressed, veined, first dark purple, at full maturity blackish and shiny, ca 5 by 9 mm, with a large lateral succulent scarlet appendage, and the lateral style almost at its base.
bibliographicCitation: Apodytes dimidiata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 81. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree, up to 15 m; branches erect. Leaves 7–19-jugate, usually teminally tufted; rachis 17–60 cm; leaflets up to 12 by 4 cm, underneath tomentose to puberulous, not glaucous, lowest reflexed. Panicles cauliflorous down to ground level, rarely axillary, up to 20 cm. Pedicels 4–17 mm, articulate near the middle. Petals 10–20 by 3–4 mm, distinct, glabrous inside. All stamens with anthers. Ovules 4–7 per cell. Berry up to 10 by 5 cm, terete-obtuse-angular in cross section. Seeds exarillate.
bibliographicCitation: Averrhoa bilimbi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 22. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 14 m; branches often drooping. Leaves 3–6-jugate, not crowded terminaly; rachis up to 20 cm; leaflets up to 10 by 4 cm, glabrescent, glaucous beneath, lowest not reflexed. Panicles axillary, rarely some ramiflorous, up to 7 cm. Pedicels 3–6 mm, articulated below the flower. Petals up to 8 by 2 mm, coherent above the claw, inside with minute septate-glandular hairs. Shorter stamens without anthers, often with swollen base. Ovules 3–5 per cell. Berry up to 12.5 by 6 cm, stellate in cross section. Aril present, bilabiate, enclosing the seed.
bibliographicCitation: Averrhoa carambola. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 21. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect, dwarf shrub, often sympodially branched, up to 30 cm. Leaves 18–27 jugate, rachis 7–17 cm; terminal leaflets oblong to lanceolate, widest on or above the middle, 9–22 by 3–8 mm, as long as the preceding, ± symmetric; other leaflets elliptic to oblong, asymmetric, midrib excentric, from basiscopic corner, sparsely strigose, glabrescent. Inflorescences distinctly peduncled, puberulous with a few septate-glandular hairy. Peduncles 5–19.5 cm. Pedicels 5–17 mm. Sepals lanceolate, 4.5–6 by 1–1.5 mm, acute, sparsely strigose to glabrous, 0.5–0.7 as long as the corolla, in fruit half to ± equally long as the pedicels, 1.2–2 times as long as the fruit. Petals 9–10 by 1–2.5 mm, rounded to truncate, white with yellowish base. Fruit 3–4 by 2–3 mm, glabrous. Seeds 2–3 per cell, ca 1 by 0.8 mm, transversally tubercled and ridged.
bibliographicCitation: Biophytum adiantoides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 20. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small, erect annual; stem simple, rarely up to 15 cm high. Leaves 3–9-jugate; rachis 0.5–3.5 cm; terminal leaflets longer than the preceding, obovate, ± oblique, 2–8 by 2–5 mm; other leaflets triangular to orbicular-elliptic, midrib ± median, rounded to obtuse, ± glabrous; nerves few, ± perpendicular to the midrib. Pedicels 1–3 mm. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, 3–5 by 0.7–1.5 mm, ca 0.6 times as long as the petals, in fruit longer than pedicel, ± exceeding the fruit. Petals lanceolate, orange, or yellow in lower half and orange or red in upper. Fruit 3–4 by 2–2.5 mm, apically ciliate on the ribs. Seeds 3–4 per cell, with two longitudinal ridges, in between with transverse rows of minute tubercles.
bibliographicCitation: Biophytum petersianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 18. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Unbranched, erect annual, up to 55 cm; stem pithy, compressible. Leaves 6–11(–14)-jugate, rachis 2.5–6.5(–10) cm; terminal leaflets obovate, largest, 7–12 by 4–7 mm, ± asymmetric; other leaflets ± symmetric, elliptic with ± parallel margins, midrib ± median at base, base truncate, ± glabrous; nerves many, little conspicuous, oblique. Inflorescences strigose and septate-glandular hairy. Peduncles up to 6.5(–12.5) cm. Pedicles up to 7 mm. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, 2.2–4 by 0.5–1 mm, acute, ± half as long as the corolla, in fruit 3–8-nerved, 0.5–0.7 as long as the pedicles, ± as long as the fruit. Petals 6–8 by 1–2 mm, rounded to emarginated, yellow, limb with red to purplish lines. Fruit 2–3 by 2–2.5 mm, apically puberulous and minutely septate-glandular hairy on the ribs. Seeds up to 3 per cell, ca 1 by 0.5 mm, transversally ridged and tubercled.
bibliographicCitation: Biophytum reinwardtii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 19. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect, unbranched annual, up to 35 cm; stem pithy, compressible. Leaves 7–12(–14)-jugate, rachis 5–10(–16.5) cm; terminal leaflets largest, falcate-obovate, 8–18 by 3–10 mm, ± asymmetric; other leaflets ± symmetric, elliptic with parallel margins, base truncate, midrib median at base, ± glabrous; nerves many, little conspicuous, oblique. Inflorescences strigose mixed with septate-glandular hairs. Peduncles up to 14 cm. Pedicels 1.5–3.5 mm. Sepals ovate-lanceolate, 4–7 by 0.5–1.5 mm, acute, ± shorter than the corolla, in fruit 5–9-nerved, longer than the pedicels, 1.3–2 times as long as the fruit. Petals 5–7 by 1–2 mm, truncate, yellow, limb with purplish lines. Fruit 3–4 by 2 mm, apically puberulous and minutely septate-glandular hairy on the ribs. Seeds up to 3 per cell, 0.7–1 by 0.5–0.8 mm, transversally tubercled and ridged.
bibliographicCitation: Biophytum sensitivum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 19. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect, dwarf shrub, often sympodially branched, up to 30 cm. Leaves 8–16-jugate, rachis 3–8 cm; terminal leaflets as long as the preceding, elliptic- to obovate-oblong, 7–15 by 4–9 mm, ± symmetric; other leaflets elliptic to oblong, asymmetric, midrib excentric, from basiscopic corner; strigose, glabrescent. Inflorescences nearly sessile in tuft, puberulous and septate-glandular hairy. Peduncles up to 2 mm. Pedicles 4–6 mm. Sepals ovate-oblong to -lanceolate; 5 by 1–2 mm, acute to acuminate, ± half as long as the corolla, in fruit ± as long as the pedicel, ± as long as the fruit. Petals 8–9 by 2–3 mm, rounded, white to yellowish white. Fruit 4 by 4 mm, sparsely puberulous and minutely septate-glandular hairy on the ribs. Seeds 4 per cell, 1 by 1 mm, transversally tubercled and ridged.
bibliographicCitation: Biophytum thorelianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 20. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, up to 30 m, 1 m diam. Leaves oblong to lanceolate, 7.5–20 by 2.5–6 cm, obtuse to acute, sometimes acuminate at apex, acute, often ± tapering at base, margin entire, ± acicular-denticulate in young treelets. Inflorescences made up of many-flowered, shortened, sessile cymes, flowering successively or simultaneously, the rachis often not growing on vegetatively after flowering; pedicels 10–15 mm, up to 20 mm in fruit, those of one cyme fixed close together in ca 3, ± distinct tiers. Torus ca 0.5 mm high, 1 mm diam., in fruit up to 3 mm high, 5 mm diam. Sepals ovate to obovate, 4–5 by 1.5–2 mm. Petals ovate to obovate, 3.5–5 by 1.5–1.8 mm. Stamens with 1–1.5 mm long filaments; anthers 1.5–2 by ca 0.5 mm. Carpels ca 0.7 by 0.5 mm; style 1.5–3 mm, in fruit up to 5 mm. Drupes up to 6.5 by 5.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Brackenridgea hookeri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 27. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, up to 30 m, 1 m diam. Leaves (ovate-)oblong to (ovate-)lanceolate, 4–12.5 by 1.5–5 cm (up to 20 cm long in young treelets), mostly acute to acuminate, sometimes obtuse at apex, rounded to acute, often ± tapering at base, margin entire, ±acicular-denticulate in young treelets. Inflorescences made up of 3(–5)-flowered, shortened cymes, sessile or with up to 0.5 cm long peduncle, flowering simultaneously, sometime 2 inflorescences of different stages in close succession, the 5–10(–25) mm long rachis growing on vegetatively, sometimes branching in the lower parts; pedicels 8–15 mm, up to 20 mm in fruit, those of one cyme fixed close together in one tier. Torus ca 0.5 mm high, 1 mm diam., in fruit up to 4 mm high, 6 mm diam. Sepals ovate to oblong, 3.5–5.5 by 1.5–3 mm. Petals ovate to obovate-lanceolate, 3.5–6 by 1.5–3 mm. Stamens with 1–2 mm long filaments; anthers 1.5–2(–3) by ca 0.5 mm. Carpels ca 0.7 by 0.5 mm; style 2.5–4 mm, in fruit up to 6 mm. Drupes up to 8 by 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Brackenridgea palustris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 27. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 23 m by 20–30 cm. Leaves thin, elliptic, 7–17 by 2–8 cm, acute, base cuneate; petiole 1–4.5 cm. Stipules 2.5–3.5 cm long. Pedicels 1–4 mm. Flowers greenish, 10–12 mm long. Calyx tube smooth, 4–6 by 2 mm, lobes 8, about as long as the tube. Petals 3–4 mm long, outer margins usually fringed with white hairs at the lower part. Stamens 1.5–2.5 mm. Hypocotyl cylindrical, often curved, 8–15 by 0.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Bruguiera cylindrica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 9. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 33 m by 70 cm. Leaves elliptic-oblong, 9–16 by 4–7 cm, acute, base cuneate; petiole 2.5–4 cm. Stipules 3.5 cm long. Pedicles 6–8 mm. Flowers pale green, 1.7–2.2 cm long. Calyx tube slightly ribbed at the upper part outside, lobes 10, as long as the tube. Petals 7–9 mm long, outer margin fringed with white hairs at the lower part. Hypocotyl cigar-shaped or slightly clavate, slightly curved, up to 9 cm by 11 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Bruguiera hainesii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 10. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 24 m by 15–30(–55) cm. Leaves elliptic, 7.5–13 by 2.5–4 cm; apex acute; base cuneate; petiole 1.5–2 cm. Stipules ca 4.5 cm long. Pedicels 6–13 mm. Flowers yellowish green. Calyx tube ridged, 7–9 mm long, lobes 8, ca 0.2–0.25 as long as the tube. Petals 1.5–2 mm long, white hairy at the lower margin. Stamens 1.5 mm. Style 1.2–1.5 mm. Hypocotyl cylindrical, 7.5–13 by 0.5 cm, smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Bruguiera parviflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 9. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 33 m by 65(–80) cm. Leaves elliptic to elliptic-oblong, rarely oblanceolate, 8–13(–16) by 3–6 cm, acute at both ends; petiole 1.5–5 cm. Stipules green or yellowish, 3.5–4 cm long. Pedicels 6–12 mm. Flowers 2.7–4 cm long. Calyx 10–12-lobed, tube 1–1.5 cm long. Petals 1.5 cm long, densely fringed with hairs along the outer margins. Stamens 7–14 mm long. Style 1.5–2.2 cm. Hypocotyl cigar-shaped, rather angular, 6–8 by 1.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Bruguiera sexangula. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 8. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 50 m by 70 cm. Leaves papyraceous to thin-coriaceous, elliptic, obovate to oblanceolate, rarely suborbicular, 5–15 by 2–10 cm, entire, serrate, or denticulate, acute to shortly acuminate, base cuneate; petiole 1 cm. Stipules 1–2.5 cm long. Inflorescences usually shining by secreted resin. Flowers shortly pedicellate or sessile. Calyx lobes deltoid. Petals suborbiculate, ca 1.5 mm in diam. Stamens ca 2 mm. Fruit globose, ca 7 mm in diam. Seeds reniform.
bibliographicCitation: Carallia brachiata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 13. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 15(–25)m by 20 cm, often shrubby under unfavourable conditions. Leaves obovate to obovate-oblong, rarely elliptic-oblong, 5–11.5 by 2–7.5 cm, obtuse or sometimes slightly emarginate, base cuneate; petioles 1.5–3.5 cm. Stiuples 1.2–2.5 cm long. Inflorescences often in the axils of the terminal nodes of a branchlet, usually resinous, (2–)4–10-flowered. Calyx 6–7 mm long. Petals oblong, ca 4 mm long, apex with 3 clavate appendages. Stamens 3–5 mm, alternately long and short. Hypocotyl 15–25(–35) cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Ceriops tagal. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 11. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Leaves coriaceous, obovate, 4–6 by 3–4 cm, base broad-cuneate, apex rounded, emarginated or apiculate, glabrous; nerves 7–10 pairs. Petiole short (2–3 mm). Cymes hairy. Calyx tube tomentose outside, ± pubescent inside. Petal white. Stamens ±20. Carpel villous. Drupe plum-sized; exocarp fleshy, yellow, red or violet, edible; stone obovoid, 25 by 15 mm, fluted.
bibliographicCitation: Chrysobalanus icaco. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 71. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Half-evergreen upright shrub with spreading branches. Leaves thickish, elliptic to ovate, 2–3 cm long, pubescent or glabrous above, whitish-tomentose beneath. Petiole 1–3 mm long. Corymbs 5–15-flowered. Calyx tube villous; lobes triangular. Petals white pinkish, upright. Carpel 3. Styles shorter than the stamens. Fruit ovoid, 6–7 mm log, orange-red, with calyx lobes persistent and turned down to the centre. Nutlets (pyrenes) usually 3.
bibliographicCitation: Cotoneaster franchetii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 36. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: A small deciduous tree up to 10 m tall, in young state having lobed or lobulate leaves and often spinescent branches. Young parts woolly-tomentose. Leaves ovate or oblong-lanceolate, 7–10 by 2–5 cm, base rounded, apex acuminate, ± serrate in the upper part, tomentose beneath, at length glabrate; nerves 6–10 pairs. Petiole 15–20 mm long. Stipules linear, deciduous. Fascicles 1–3-flowered. Flowers 2.5–3 cm across, subsessile, densely woolly. Calyx lobes narrowly lanceolate. Petals white. Fruit globose or ovoid, 3–4 cm in diameter, yellow-green.
bibliographicCitation: Docynia indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 46. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb with many long slender stolons. Leaves 3(–5)-foliolate. Leaflets petiolulate or sessile, obovate, crenate, toothed or serrate, ± hairy. Petiole 3–10 cm, very slender. Stipules narrowly lanceolate, entire or toothed. Peduncles very slender, equaling the petiole or longer. Flowers 15–25 mm across. Calyculus lobes obovate, toothed, exceeding ovate-lanceolate entire calyx lobe. Petals obovate. Fruit spherical, red, spongy, insipid. . Achenes obscurely pitted.
bibliographicCitation: Duchesnea indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 61. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, 15–20 by 4–7 cm, base cuneate, apex acute, remotely dentate, lustrous above, woolly beneath; nerves about 15 pairs. Petiole very short (5 mm). Stipule subulate, ± persistent. Panicles 7–15 cm long and broad; branches very stout, woolly. Flowers sessile, 15–20 mm across, frangrant. Calyx lobes ovate, subacute. Petals white. Ovary inferior, 5-locular. Styles 5. Fruit globose or ovoid, 2–3 cm in diameter, yellow; pericarp fleshy. Seeds large.
bibliographicCitation: Eriobotrya japonica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 42. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: This insufficiently represented species is very closely related to E. bengalensis. It differs only by the large (up to 10 x 10 mm) long-persistent, entire or toothed stipules. Perhaps only a form of E. bengalensis.
bibliographicCitation: Eriobotrya stipularis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 44. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub up to 6 m. Leaves oblong to linear-oblong. 8–40 by 2–10 cm, actue at apex, tapering at base, margin distinctly and irregularly denticulate, nerves 1–2 mm apart; petiole 2–5 cm, slightly winged. Panicles 8–20 cm long; pedicels 4–10 mm, articulate at base; bracts 8–10 by 2–4 mm, lanceolate, acute. Flowers often in pairs. Sepals obliquely ovate to elliptic, unequal, 4–7 by 2–3.5 mm, ciliate. Petals obliquely obovate to spatulate, 4–10 by 2.5–5 mm. Anthers 3–5 by ca 1 mm; style 1.5–3 mm. Fruit globular, up to 1 cm diam., fleshy, via red turning white. Seeds like sectors of a sphere, ca 4 by 2 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Euthemis leucocarpa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 29. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree with wiry branches. Leaves as described in key, nerves 4–5 pairs. Flowers and drupes apparently slightly smaller than in var. quadrifida.
bibliographicCitation: Gomphandra quadrifida angustifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 79. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree with wiry branches. Leaves as described in key, nerves 4–5 pairs. Flowers and drupes apparently slightly smaller than in var. quadrifida.
bibliographicCitation: Gomphandra quadrifida ovalifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 79. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree or shrub. Leaves oblong to elliptic, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, glabrous, (5–)8–11 by 3–5 cm, nerves 5–6 pairs. Drupe oblong-ellipsoid, 1.2–1.5(–2) by 0.5–0.8 cm, not or hardly swollen at the base.
bibliographicCitation: Gomphandra tetrandra. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 79. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree, up to 25 m, 40 cm diam; branchlets of young plants sometimes scrambling. Leaves ovate-to obovate-lanceolate, 6–20 by 2–6 cm (up to 35 by 10 cm in young plants), acute to acuminate, sometimes obtuse at apex, acute or a little tapering at base, margin finely denticulate. Inflorescences many-flowered; rachis (2.5–)5–20(–35) cm, primary branches of terminal inflorescences up to 10(–15) cm, secondary branches or primary branches of lateral inflorescences usually reduced or up to 1 cm long, cymose, with (1–)3–7(–∞), ± conferted flowers; pedicels 0.5–0.8 mm, up to 1 cm in fruit. Torus 0.7–1 mm high, 0.7–1 mm diam., in fruit up to 5 mm high, 5 mm diam. Sepals mostly ovate to elliptic, sometimes obovate, 4–7 by 2.5–4 mm, mostly acute to obtuse, sometimes rounded. Petals obliquely obovate to broad-spatulate, 4.5–8 by 2.5–6 mm, obtuse, rounded, or truncate, mostly yellow, sometimes creamy or white. Stamens subsessile or with up to 0.5 mm long filaments; anthers 2.5–5(–6) by 0.5–0.8 mm. Carpels 0.7–1 by 0.4–0.6 mm; style 3–5 mm, up to 7 mm in fruit. Drupes up to 8(–10) by 6(–8) mm.
bibliographicCitation: Gomphia serrata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 28. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree, 2–7(–15) m; bark smooth, grey to brown. Branches slender, tips puberulous. Leaves oblong to elliptic, sometimes obovate-elliptic, apex shortly obtusely and rather abruptly acuminate, base cuneate to rounded, coriaceous, (8–)10–16(–25) by (2.5–)3–8(–11) cm, nerves 4–6(–7) pairs, reticulation rather coarse and slightly raised above; petiole 1–1, 5 cm by 2 mm. Inflorescence 0.3–1.5(–3) cm, sparsely appressedly hairy. Petals greenish white, (4–)5–6(–7) by 2 mm in the ♂, ca 2.5 mm in the ♀ flowers. Drupe oblong-ellipsoid, rarely subovoid-oblong, 3–4(–5) by 2–2.7(–3) cm, both ends roundish or more attenuate, apex even shortly apiculate or sub-rostrate (especially in immature or empty fruits), green for a long time, finally bluish-purplish or blackish, ribs of the endocarp in the dry fruit merely showing as very shallow grooves or low ribs; aborted loculus generally conspicuous; exocarp spongy-fibrous, 2–3(–4) mm; endocarp hard, 1–1.5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Gonocaryum lobbianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 80. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 15–30(–45) m by 30–50 cm. Leaves ovate to lanceloate, clliptic- or obovate-oblong. 4.5–20 by 1.5–9 cm; apex bluntly or shortly acuminate, or acute; base acute rarely obtuse; petiole 0.5–1 cm. Stipules 1.5 cm long. Bracteoles sometimes condensed into short, tubercular glomerules. Calyx lobes ovate, 1.5–2.5 mm long. Petals obovate rarely elliptic, 2–2.5 mm long, divided into filamentous appendages at the upper third or half. Stamens 1–1.5 mm, incurved. Fruits globose, ca 3 mm in diam.
bibliographicCitation: Gynotroches axillaris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 14. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves decussate, obovate, orbicular, ovate or oblong, 3–10 by 1.5–4 mm, the margin on either side with 1–7 teeth; petiole 0–2 mm. Racemes simple or little branched, erect, ± spike-like, 1–8 cm long. Pedicels 0.25–0.75 mm. Flowers erect, then nodding. Sepals subsaccate-thickened and shallowly cordate at the base, triangular-ovate, often acuminate, 0.3–0.6 mm long. Petals red or rose, ca 0.9–1.3 mm. Stamens 8, anthers 0.3–0.7 mm. Styles curved inward, 0.2–0.3 mm. Fruit obovoid-globose to depressed-globose, smooth, ca 0.9–1.1. by 0.7–0.9 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Haloragis micrantha. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 3. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, 5–10(–18) m, stem up to 8 cm diam. Branchlets slender, rusty-tomentellous. Leaves ovate to ovate-elliptic, apex short-acuminate, base rounded to subcordate, firmly chartaceous, midrib and nerves of the upper surface and the whole undersurface covered with erect to obliquely spreading hairs forming a tomentum soft to the touch, 5–15(–18) by 3.5–8(–11.5) cm, nerves 4–6 pairs, curved and rather steeply ascending, prominent beneath as are midrib and net of veins and veinlets; petiole 1–2(–3.5) cm. ♂ inflorescences covered all over with a short rusty tomentum, 2–12 cm incl. Peduncle (1–4 cm); pedicels 1–2 mm. Calyx 5-partite to almost the base, substrigose. Petals oblong-lanceolate, white or yellowish, 2–3 mm. ♂ flowers: anthers subsessile; rudiment of ovary hairy. ♀ flowers: petals and staminodia absent; ovary cylindric, substrigose, 1 mm. Drupe obliquely ovoid, laterally compressed and crested, shortly ± appressedly rusty-tomentose, 1.2–1.5(–2) by 1–1.2(–1.5) by 0.7–1 cm; exocarp thin, reddish; endocarp hard, coarsely lacunose-reticulate.
bibliographicCitation: Iodes cirrhosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 86. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Similar in habit, and characters of flower and fruit, but indumenta of the under-surface of leaves consisting of both rather lax, ± appressed, robust, and other, generally predominant finer, soft ± erect hairs.
bibliographicCitation: Iodes vitiginea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 87. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree up to ca 7 m tall. Leaves elliptic to narrow-elliptic, or obovate-oblong, 6–13 by 2.5–6 cm, obtuse, base cuneate; petiole 1–1.5 cm. Stipules 2 cm long. Pedicels 2–3 mm. Bracteoles 2–4, connate. Flowers white, 1.5–2 cm long. Calyx 1–1.5 cm long, lobes linear, reflexed after anthesis. Petals ca 14 mm long. Stamens 8–13 mm. Fruits ovoid, 1.5–2.5 cm long. Hypocotyl clavate, 15–40 cm long, terete.
bibliographicCitation: Kandelia candel. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 12. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree 5 to 10 m. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-lanceolate, 7–10 by 2–4 cm, base acute, apex acuminate, glabrous and polished on both surfaces; nerves faint, 7–9 paris, Petiole 5 mm long. Flowers in axillary and terminal raceme-like cymes, shorter than the leaves. Pedicel very short. Calyx tomentose; tube 1.5 mm long; lobes train-gular acute, 1 mm long. Petals as long as the sepals. Stamens 5–1-. Ovary villous. Fruit ellipsoid, 8–12 by 5 mm, yellow or red, smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Licania splendens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 72. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large tree up to 30 m. Bark pale smooth, peeling off in the upper part of the bole. Leaves coriaceous, obong-lanceolate, 7–15 by 2.5–8 cm, base decurrent cuneate, apex acuminate, glabrous, very glossy on the upper surface; nerves 7–10 pairs. Petiole 5–6 mm long with 2 small glands near the blade. Flowers in many-flowered terminal panicles. Pedicel 2–3 mm long. Calyx tube 1.5–2.5 mm; lobes obtuse, 2–4 mm long, unequal. Petals white-pinkish, up to 5 mm long. Stamens: fertile ones at the opposite side of the style. Ovary densely woolly and with siky bristles on its basal part. Style glabrous. Fruit ellipsoid, up to 4 x 2 cm; exocarp violet-black when ripe, edible.
bibliographicCitation: Maranthes corymbosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 74. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree, rarely up to 10 m, stem up to 20 cm diam.; bark smooth, grey-green. Branches pendulous, tips pubescent. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, acuminate, membranous, light green, showing numerous fine pores against strong light, under-surface often with minute tubercles, (5–)8–13(–20) by (1–)2–4(–8) cm, nerves (4–)5–6 (rarely–8) paris, without reticulation; petiole slender, (0.6–)1–1.5 cm. Peduncles 2–4–(–7) cm, short-hairy as are the cymose branches of the inflorescences. Petals greenish white, 2(–2.5) mm. Drupe subovate-oblong, base truncate and hollow, apex subacuminate, 1.2–1.5 by 0.5–0.6(–0.7) cm.
bibliographicCitation: Medusanthera gracilis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 77. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large climber with corky bark. Leaves elliptic-oblong or lanceolate, rather abruptly acuminate, entire, or rarely coarsely few-lobed or toothed, membranous to chartaceous, strigose when young, 12–20 by 4–7 cm, nerves 7–12 arcuate pairs, the lowest from near the base; petiole 1.3–5 cm. Flowers greenish, in pubescent heads. ♂ flower heads 15–20-flowered; peduncles filiform, 2–5 cm, racemosely disposed on a short supra-axillary protuberance. Calyx 3–5-cleft, separated from the lobes of the petals by a pedicle-like up to 4 mm long tube of the petals adnate to the flower axis, lobes ± as long as the tube. Filaments very short. ♀ flowers in 10–15-flowered heads, these solitary on a rather short and robust penduncle; tube of petals short or absent. Drupe oblong-ellipsoid, laterally compressed, both ends rounded, i.e. very base hardly or not narrowed, yellowish, 1.2–1.5 by 0.7–0.8 by 0.5 cm, tubercled outside.
bibliographicCitation: Miquelia kleinii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 89. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Terrestrial, not more than 5 cm high, rooting at the nodes. Leaves spirally arranged, rarely subopposite, entire or rarely ± pinnate with 1–2 filiform segments ca 3 by 0.3 mm. Flowers monoecious, with subulate, up to 0.1 mm long bracteoles, sessile or nearly so. ♂ flowers without sepals, the petals oblong to lanceolate, ca 1 mm long, strongly recurved after anthesis, persistent. Stamen 1, on very short filament, the anther broadly elliptic, 0.5–0.9 by 0.3–0.5 mm. ♀ flower without sepals and petals. Fruit 0.5–1 by 0.5–1 mm, with 2 mericarps; these tubercled, with a crown of ± spiny tubercles.
bibliographicCitation: Myriophyllum siamense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 2. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Aquatic or semiterrestrial. Immersed leaves in whorls of (4–)5–6, pinnate with filiform segments, 2–5 by 1.5–4 cm outline. Middle and upper aerial leaves mostly narrowly triangular to linear, mostly 2–4 by 0.5–1 mm. Flowers ♂♀ or the upper ♂. Bracteoles digitate or sometimes ± pinniform, 0.6–1 mm long. Petals caducous before anthesis, ca 1–1.5 mm long. Stamens 4; anthers ± oblong, 0.6–1 by 0.2–0.3 mm. Fruit cruciform, ca 2 by 2 mm, the 4 mericarps ± ovate, with convex back and ± flattened sides, finely tuberculate to smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Myriophyllum tetrandrum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 2. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: A soft-haired climber. Leaves cordate, acuminate, edge obsoletely repand, minutely dentate by the excurrent nerves, membranous, covered on both faces with short subappressed stiff hairs, 7–15 by 5–12 cm, 7–9-palmately nerved, each main nerve giving off 1 or 2 lateral ones, nerves and transverse veins slightly raised beneath; petiole strigose, slender, 5–15 cm. Flowers greenish yellow, in hirsute racemes up to 12 cm; bracts linear. Pedicels up to 3 mm. Calyx lobes with coarse hairs. Petals lanceolate, hairy, ca 2 mm. Drupe ovoid, somewhat oblique and tapering, laterally compressed, 8–10 by 6–8 by 4–5 mm; endocarp crustaceous, shallowly coarsely reticulate-lacunose.
bibliographicCitation: Natsiatum herpeticum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 88. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree, up to 10 m. Branches hirsute, becoming glabrate. Leaves spiral, or opposite at the terminal dichotomies of the shoots, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, apex short-acuminate, base broadly cuneate to rounded, unequal, membranous to chartaceous, sparsely to densely hirsute on both faces especially at midrib and nerves, and also on petioles and inflorescences, 9–18 by 4–9 cm, nerves 6–10 rather steeply curved-ascending pairs; petiole 3–5 cm. Corymbosely arranged cymes long-pedunculate, many-flowered, 5–10 cm diam. Petals white, 4.5–6 by 1.5 mm, densely to sparsely villose within. Filaments 3–4 mm; anthers 1–1.3 mm. Drupe oblong-ovoid or ellipsoid, 1.2 by 0.8–1 cm, black, generally short-pubescent; endosperm of seed with a fetid smell.
bibliographicCitation: Nothapodytes foetida. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 82. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Treelet or tree, rarely up to 20 m. Branchlets early covered with pale brown cork. Leaves lanceolate to obovate-oblong, apex obliquely and subacutely acuminate (1–2 cm), base cuneate, ± equilateral, herbaceous to chartaceous, shining above, practically glabrous, often laxly tubercled beneath, nerves in 6–9 pairs, curved or more straight, widely patent, reticulation of veinlets rather dense and finely raised on both surfaces; petiole 1–2 (rarely –2.5) cm. Corymbs rather few-flowered, 2–4 cm across, peduncle slender, 2–4 cm, densely appressedly yellowish hairy in all outer parts. Petals greenish white, 4–5 by 1.5–2(–3) mm, glabrous all over or with scattered hairs in the lower part within. Filaments 3–4 mm; anthers 1.5 mm. Drupe ellipsoid, greenish brown when fresh, blackish when dry, rather smooth, ca 1.5 by 1 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Nothapodytes montana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 83. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Deciduous undershrub, shrub, or tree, up to 12 m, 45 cm diam. Leaves obovate-oblng or (obovate-) lanceolate, rarely obovate or linear-lanceolate, 6–20(–25) by 2–7 cm, acuminate, sometimes acute or obtuse at apex, acute, sometimes obtuse at base, margin finely denticulate. Inflorescences many-flowered; rachis 0.5–1.5(–4) cm; branches 1–3 flowered, monochasial; pedicels 2–4 cm, up to 5 cm in fruit, the basal 2–8 m persistent. Torus 0.5–1 mm high, 1.5–2.5 mm diam., in fruit up to 6 mm high, 10 mm diam. Sepals 5, ovate to ovate-oblong, 10–16 by 4–9 mm. Petals 5–6(–10), obovate, 15–25 by 8–15 mm, tapering at base or subunguiculate. Stamens (25–)30–60(–75); filaments 2.5–7 mm, unequal, the outermost longest; anthers 4–6 by 0.4–0.8 mm. Carpels 6–10(–15), 0.7–1.1 by 0.5–0.7 mm; style 10–15 by ca 0.5 mm, up to 20 mm in fruit; stigmas sometimes on up to 1 mm long branches. Drupes up to 11 by 8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Ochna integerrima. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 25. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small perennial herb, ascending to erect, rooting at the nodes. Stipules present, small. Leaflets broadly to elliptic-obcordate, 4–20(–25) by 5–18(–25) mm, incised to halfway; petiole 1–5.5(–10) mm. Peduncles up to 20 mm, usually much shorter, bearing 1–5(–8) flowers. Pedicels up to 20 mm, articulate at base and beneath the calyx, in fruit straight to bent at the articulations. Sepals lanceolate, 2–6 by 0.5–2 mm. Petals spathulate-obong to -lanceolate, 3.5–10 mm long, yellow. Longer filaments without dorsal tooth. Fruit 9–20(–24) by 2–4 mm, linear-cylindric, pentagonal, minutely puberulous, green. Seeds 5–11 per cell.
bibliographicCitation: Oxalis corniculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 17. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen tree. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-lanceolate 5–8 by 3–4 cm, base acute, apex acuminate, glabrous; nerves 4–6 pairs, faint. Petiole 6 mm long. Racemes axillary. 7–8 cm long, glabrous. Pedicel very short. Fruit yellowish, ellipsoid, 12 by 6 mm, quite smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Parastemon urophyllus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 72. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 10–30 m. Leaves coriaceous, ovate or elliptic, 6–15 by 4–9 cm, base rounded or broadly cuneate, apex obtuse or broadly acuminate, glabrous above, white-brownish woolly beneath; nerves 12–15 pairs, distinctly raised beneath. Petiole 8–10 mm long, usually with 2 small glands below the middle. Flowers in terminal panicles, longer than the leaves. Pedicel very short or indistinct. Calyx tube 2–2.5 mm long; lobes acute, 1.5 mm long. Petals white, as long as the calyx lobes. Stamens 5–12(fertile 8–10), unequal. Ovary densely pilose. Style glabrous in upper part. Fruit sub-globose or ellipsoid, 30–40 by 30 mm, covered by grey scabs; exocarp edible.
bibliographicCitation: Parinari anamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 73. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to ca 18 m tall. Leaves elliptic to elliptic-oblong, 10–19 by 5–7 cm, pubescent with simple hairs on both surfaces, abruptly acute, base rounded or cuneate; petiole 7–10 mm. Pedicels ca 7 mm. Calyx 8–12 mm long, minutely stellate-hairy outside, villous inside. Petals white, obovate, 2–3 mm long, fringed. Ovary ca 0.16–0.25 times the length of the calyx tube; style columnar, 6–8 mm, hairy at the lower 0.65.
bibliographicCitation: Pellacalyx parkinsonii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 15. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 15 m. Leaves elliptic-oblong to rarely obovate, 12–18.5 by 3–6.5 cm, usually glabrous rarely with minute, stellate hairs on both faces, entire, rarely serrulate, shortly acuminate, base rounded or cuneate; petiole 8–10 mm. Pedicels ca 7 mm. Calyx 5.5–9 mm long, glabrous, or sparsely short-hairy outside, with short. straight hairs inside. Petals obovate, 1.5–2.5 mm long, apex rounded, sometimes slightly emarginate and denticulate. Ovary 0.16–0.25 times the length of the calyx tube; style columnar, 2–3 mm. Fruits subglobose, 10 mm in diam. Seeds ellipsoid, 1–1.5 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Pellacalyx saccardianus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 15. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree. Leaves lanceolate, 5–8 by 2–3 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate, serrate, white-woolly when young, glabrous when old; nerves 8–10 pairs. Petiole 5–6 mm long. Corymbs sessile, short, few-flowered, white-woolly when young, glabrous and warted when fruiting. Pedicel 1–2 mm long. Calyx lobes acute or obtuse. Petals white, obovate, glabrous. Stamens about 20. Ovary pilose at the top. Styles 3, connate below the middle, glabrous. Fruit globose, 6 mm in diameter, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Photinia arguta arguta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 40. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Corymbs many-flowered, 5–8 cm long.
bibliographicCitation: Photinia arguta hookeri. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 41. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves narrowly lanceolate, 8–12 by 1.5–3 cm. Fruits ovoid or turbinate, up to 10 by 8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Photinia arguta salicifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 41. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen shrub or small tree quite glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, oblanceolate 8–12 by 3–4 cm, base cuneate, apex shortly acuminate, entire, glabrous; nerves 10–15 pairs with numerous and conspicuous intermediate veins. Petiole 10–30 mm long. Corymbs large, spreading, glabrous or pubescent. Pedicel very short (1–3 mm). Calyx lobes rounded. Petals white, ovate. Apex of the ovary densely pilose. Styles 2, free. Fruit globose, ± 5 mm in diameter, with calyx lobes inflexed at the top.
bibliographicCitation: Photinia integrifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 39. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen shrub or small tree quite glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, oblong-lanceolate, 6–10 by 2–3 cm, base cuneate, apex acuminate, serrate, glabrous; nerves about 10 pairs. Petiole about 10 mm long. Corymbs short (2–5 cm long), few-flowered (about 20 flowers), glabrous. Pedicel 5–10 mm long. Calyx lobes acute, ± glandular on the margin. Petals white, obovate, villous at the base inside. Stamens about 20. Apex of the ovary densely pilose. Styles 2, ± connate and pilose at base, free and glabrous in the upper part. Fruit globose, 5 mm in diameter, red.
bibliographicCitation: Photinia stenophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 40. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: High climbing liana, stem up to 2.5 cm diam., with spiny tubercles 1 mm. Branchlets setose and minutely prickly. Leaves broadly ovate, often 3-lobed and obscurely dentate then, apex acute, base cordate, glabrous and asperulous above, densely covered with short brownish hairs and soft to the touch beneath, though the nerves are set with stiffer bristle-like hairs, 10–20 by 7–15 cm, basal palmate nerves 7, upper pinnate ones 2–3, curved-ascending, slightly impressed above, prominent beneath as is the low reticulation; petiole 3–7 cm. ♂ panicles mainly axillary, solitary or 2–3 together, spike-like, shortly greyish to brownish tomentose all over, 10–20 by 2 cm, similar to those of P. palmata, but pedicles subtended by a filiform persistent out standing bract (c. 1 cm). ♀ flowers in oblong to subglobular peduncled head, these solitary or 2–3 per axil. Drupes in pendulous globose masses up to 20 cm diam., each drupe ovoid-oblongoid, tapering to both ends, densely covered with appressed long soft yellowish bristles, 4.5–8 by 1.5–2.3 cm; endocarp minutely pitted outside, faintly tubercled inside, up to 4 by 2 by 1.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Phytocrene bracteata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 91. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber in tall trees, stem up to 1.5 cm diam.; bark brownish. Branchlets with numerous fine prickly lenticels. Leaves oblong or oblong-lanceolate, ± abruptly short-acuminate, coriaceous, glabrous and shining above, rather densely set with stiff short hairs and rough to the touch beneath, early glabrescent, entire or undulate-subdentate, (10–)12–22 by 4–9 cm, nerves 5–7 pairs, one pair basal, all nerves ascending and looping, prominent as is the rather dense reticulation beneath; petiole 1.2–1.5 cm by 2–3 mm. ♂ panicles axillary or mostly clustered on woody tubercles on stem and larger branches, consisting of numerous stalked (2–5 mm) and few-flowered, ± densely arranged umbellules, patently rusty or rufous-tomentose all over, 2.5–5 by 0.5–1.5 cm; bracts shorter than pedicel. ♀ flowers in peduncled globose heads (c. 8 mm diam.), borne on stem and branches, brownish-rufous tomentose in all parts. Drupes in globular masses 6–11 cm diam., each drupe ovoid to ovoid-oblong, obtuse, very apex only apiculate by the persistent style, with stout straight reddish brown subulate prickles (5–8 mm), which leave circular pits in the endocarp, (3–)3.5–4 by 2–2.5 cm incl. the prickles; endocarp slightly tubercled inside, ca 2 by 1 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Phytocrene oblonga. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 90. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Liana. Stem generally not branched below; young parts with prickles (1 mm), tips rufous-hispid. Leaves only in the upper part of the branches, orbicular to reniform in outline, deeply palmately 5(–7)-lobed, lobes oblong to oblong-obovate, ± acuminate, base of lamina deeply cordate, glabrous and shining above, densely covered with longish coarse subappressed rufous to yellowish hairs especially on nerves and soft to the touch beneath, 15–10 cm long and wide, lateral nerves per lobe 3–4, curved-ascending and looping, with more numerous coarse transverse veins in a ± right angle from the main nerve, reticulation coarse, ± deeply impressed above, much raised beneath as are all nerves; petiole 7–12.5 cm. ♂ panicles subcylindric, axillary or from lower part of stem, (6–)15–10 by ca 3.5 cm, rufous or rusty tomentose all over, the ultimate branches bearing small, 12–15-flowered umbellules or heads, part of them subtended by a ± caduceus subulate bract 2–4 mm. ♀ flowers in peduncled (c. 6 mm) axillary ovoid heads, ca 1 cm diam. Drupes numerous, collected in sub-globular heads 7–10 cm diam., each drupe elongate-ellipsoid or slightly-obovoid, much tapering to the base, densely set with yellowish shining stiff hairs, (3.5–)4–5.5 by 1.6–2(–2.5) cm; endocarp laxly pitted outside, low-papillate inside.
bibliographicCitation: Phytocrene palmata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 91. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or treelet, up to 5 m. Branchlets smooth, red brown, no lenticles, tips yellowish short-pubescent as are petioles and inflorescences. Leaves oblong or oblong-lanceolate, apex subacutely acuminate for ca 1 cm, base attenuate, subequal, chartaceous to thinly coriaceous, practically glabrous, 10–21 by (3–)4–7 cm, nerves 5–7 paris slightly impressed above, prominent beneath as is the midrib, reticulation of veins coarse and minutely raised; petiole 1.5–2 cm. Cymes several on common axillary peduncle (102.5 cm), branches 5–10 mm, few- to rather many-flowered; pedicels ca 2 mm, with 3–4 small bracts. Calyx cup-shaped, 1.5–2 mm, lobed halfway. Petals oblong-spathulate, white, 6–7 by 2 mm, glabrescent. Filaments ca 5 mm; anthers ca 2 mm. Ovary glabrous; style 2–3 mm; stigma small. Drupe ovoid to subglobose, slightly flattened, green to greenish white, 2–2.5 by 2 by 0.5–1.7 cm, crowned by a short style, subtended by the accrescent calyx ca 6 mm diam., endocarp 0.4 mm, smooth inside and outside.
bibliographicCitation: Pittosporopsis kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 84. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Lofty tree, bole up to 60 cm diam.; bark grey to brown, rather smooth, outer part red in cross section, inner yellowish white, with a peculiar aromatic agreeable coumarine-like smell and very bitter taste also found in the leaves. Tip of branchlets, inflorescences, petioles and young blades covered with a rather coarse woolly rusty and detersile tomentum of flattish to obliquely erect star-shaped or fascicled hairs, and with minor scales, which fall early. Leaves elliptic to ovate or oblong-elliptic, thinly coriaceous, at maturity glabrous and shining above, and dull yellowish or greenish-greyish to almost bluish (as in Lauraceae and Myristicaceae) beneath, still covered there with sparse star-shaped hairs especially along midrib and nerves, and besides over the whole undersurface with a skin-like layer of small, thin, ± confluent, finally silvery scales, seemingly glabrous to the naked eye, 10–20(–25) by 5–11 cm, nervers 6–10 pairs, reticulation rather faint; petiole 2–4 cm, ♂ inflorescences ± pyramidal (2–)4–6 cm in circumference. Petals light green, 1.5 mm. Drupe narrowly ovoid-ellipsoid, variable in size, 2.5–4.5 by 2–2.5 cm; exocarp fleshy, first lemon-yellow to reddish orange, finally blackish especially when dry, of a bitter taste.
bibliographicCitation: Platea latifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 76. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual or biennial herb. Stems prostrate or suberect. Leaves pinnate, 3–7 foliolate. Leaflets petioluate, obovate cuneate, irregularly incised, serrate or lobed, ± villous. Stipules membranous in the lower leaves or leafy in the upper. Flowers solitary or corymbose, 4–8 mm across. Pedicel 2–12 mm. Calyculus lobes ovate acute; calyx lobes oblong obtuse. Petals loblong obovate, smaller than the calyx lobes. . Achenes minute, smooth or ridged. Style subterminal, shorter than the achene. Receptacle villous.
bibliographicCitation: Potentilla supina. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 62. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree. Leaves elliptic or ovate, 6–20 by 2–7 cm, base rounded or broad-cuneate unequal, apex acute to acuminate, entire, usually pubescent beneath; nerves 8–12 paris; basal glands (0–)2, flat to hollowed. Petiole 5–10 mm. Stipules linear, deciduous. Recemes axillary in bundles of 2–6, simple or compound, 2–5 cm long, pubescent. Pedicel very short. Calyx tube pubescent outside, hairy inside on bottom; calyx lobes 7–12, subequal. Petals 0 (not differentiated from calyx lobes) or in one ± distinct whorl. Stamens 20–30. Ovary usually densely hairy, sometimes glabrous. Drupe globular to didymous, 6–10 by 7–15 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus arborea montana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 71. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Deciduous tree. Leaves ovate or lanceolate, 5–12 by 3–5 cm, acuminate, broad-cuneate, simply or double serrate, glabrous; nerves 9–12 paris Petiole 8–15 mm long with 0–2–4 glands. Stipules laciniate subulate, glandular, deciduous. Inflorescences from lateral buds, fascicled or umbelled, often 3-flowered, glabrous. Pedicel slender, 7–20 mm. Flowers rose or white, 10–20 mm across. Calyx tube rose, glabrous; calyx lobes triangular acute or obtuse. Ovary glabrous. Drupe ovoid or ellipsoid, 1.5 cm long, red; stone bony, rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus cerasoides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 68. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree. Leaves elliptic-loblong or ovate-lanceolate, 6–18 by 3–9 cm, base acute or rounded, apex acuminate, entire, glabrous above, ± pubescent beneath; nerves 5–9 pairs; basal glands (0–)2(–4), flat. Petiole 1–2 cm. Stipules linear, deciduous. Racemes axillary, solitary, 3–10 cm. Pedicel 1–4 mm. Calyx tube pubescent outside, glabrous inside except on bottom; calyx lobes 5, rarely 4 or 6, triangular, minute. Petals elliptic to orbicular, minute. Stamens 20–40. Ovary with a ring of hairs around base. Drupe transversely ellipsoid to didymous, 9–18 by 14–25 mm, glabrous.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus ceylanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 70. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree or shrub. Leaves ovate or lanceolate, 4–14 by 2–6 cm, base rounded or actue, apex acuminate, glabrous; nerves 5–9 pairs; basal glands usually 2, flat. Petiole 0.5–1 cm. Stipules linear, deciduous. Racemes axillary, solitary, 1–3 cm long. Pedicel very short. Calyx tube pubescent outside, glabrous inside or with hairs on bottom; calyx lobes 7–10 minute. Petals 0 (not differentiated from calyx lobes). Stamens 20–30. Ovary usually glabrous. Drupe globose to transversely ellipsoid, 6–12 by 8–12 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus grisea tomentosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 70. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 30 m. Leaves oblong-ovate, 8–15 by 3–6 cm, base rounded to acute, apex acuminate, margin entire, glabrous, densely black-dotted beneath, sometimes 2-glandular in the basal part; nerves 8–12 paris. Petiole 6–12 mm long. Stipules linear, deciduous. Racemes axillary, usually solitary, 2–6 cm long. glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Pedicel 2–6 mm. Calyx tube glabrous or pubescent outside, glabrous inside; calyx lobes minute, obtuse. Petals white, broad-ovate or orbicular, 3 by 3 mm. Stamens 25–50. Ovary glabrous. Style glabrous. Drupe ovoid to ellipsoid, acute, 20 by 8 mm; stone thin smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus javanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 69. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Deciduous tree. Leaves lanceolate, 8–15 by 1.5–2 cm, acuminate base cuneate with 2 sessile glands, serrate, glabrous: nerves 8–10 pairs. Petiole 5–15 mm long. Stipules subulate, glandular, deciduous, Flowers usually solitary, pink, 2.5–3.5 cm across, very short-stalked. Calyx lobes elliptic-ovate, obtuse, pubescent outside. Ovary tomentose. Style villous below, glabrous above. Drupe globose, 5–7 cm, tomentose; stone deeply pitted and furrowed, very hard.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus persica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 67. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree. Leaves oblong-lanceolate, 6–12 by 2–4 cm, base acute, apex acuminate-caudate, margin entire or serrate, glabrous, densely black-dotted beneath and with 2 flat glands in the basal part; nerves 6–9 pairs. Petiole 3–6 cm long. Stipules linear, glandular-serrate, deciduous. Racemes axilary, solitary, 3–6cm long, glabrous. Pedicel 5 mm. Calyx tube glabrous outside, villous at bottom inside; calyx lobes rounded, laciniate-ciliate. Petals white, orbicular, 3 by 3 mm. Stamens 20–35. Ovary glabrous. Style glabrous. Drupe globose, 6–10 mm; stone thin, smooth or slightly rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus phaeosticta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 69. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree. Leaves thin, oblong-lanceolate, 8–15 by 3–5 cm, base broad-cuneate to rounded, apex acuminate, margin entire or remotely serrate, glabrous, sometimes dotted beneath with scarce minute glands; nerves 8–10 pairs looped and joined near the margin. Petiole 8–10 mm. Stipules linear early deciduous. Racemes axillary, solitary or in fascicles of 2–3, 2–10 mm long, glabrous or sparsely pubescent. Pedicel 2–8 mm. Calyx tube glabrous outside, hairy inside in the basal part; calyx lobes minute, obtuse. Petals yellowish white, elliptic, 2–4 mm long. Stamens 10–20. Ovary ± hairy. Style glabrous. Drupe ovoid, subacute, 15 x 8 mm; stone thin, smooth.
bibliographicCitation: Prunus wallichii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 68. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Half-evergreen tree. Leaves ovate, 8–10 by 4–5 cm, base rounded or subcordate, apex acuminate, serrate or denticulate, pubescent when young becoming glabrous. Flowers white. Fruit broad-ellipsoid, apple-shaped, spotted, with calyx lobes persistent, very gritty, insipid.
bibliographicCitation: Pyrus lindleyi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 45. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub 2–8 m tall. Leaves coriaceous, lanceolate-oblong or obovate, 5–10 by 2–4 cm, narrowed at base, acuminate, acute or obtuse at apex, ± serrate in the upper part, entire in the lower half, glabrous; nerves 6–12 paris. Petiole 10–30 mm long. Stipules minute, subulate, deciduous. Panicles 3–10 cm long tomentose or glabrous. Calyx tomentose or glabrous; calyx lobes subulate, acute or obtuse. Petals white or pink. Stamens about 20. Ovary glabrous. Styles glabrous or pilose. Fruit globose, bluish black, 3–5 mm in diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Rhaphiolepis indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 44. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 30 m or more, 50 cm diam. Leaves elliptic-oblong to sublanceolate, 7–18 by 3–8 cm; apex acute to apiculate; base cuneate; petiole 1.5–3 cm. Stipules 4–8 cm long. Flowers sessile. Calyx lobes ovate, concave, acute, 10–14 mm long. Petals lanceolate, 8–11 mm long, membranous, flat, glabrous. Stamens mostly 12: 4 epipetalous and 4 pairs episepalous, 6–7.5 mm long. Free part of the ovary 1.5–2.5 mm high, enclosed by the disk; hypocotyls cylindrical-clavate, ± blunt, up to 38 cm by 12 mm before falling.
bibliographicCitation: Rhizophora apiculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 6. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub with ± hooked prickles or nearly unarmed. Leaflets (3–)5(–7) ovate-oblong, acuminate, serrate, glabrous. Stipules adnate to the petiole, narrow, glandular-ciliate. Flowers corymbose, rarely solitary, single or double, 5 cm across. Pedicel 5–10 cm long, ± glandular. Calyx lobes narrowly triangular, ± leafy and serrate at the apex and ± divided near the base Petals pink or red, not or slightly fragrant. Styles free, exserted. Fruit pear-shaped, 15–20 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa chinensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 65. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sarmentose shrub with straight prickles and sometimes glandular hairs. Leaflets 7–11, elliptic or oblong, 1–2.5 b 0.5–1 cm, apex acute, finely serrate, glabrous on both surfaces or villous and glandular on the lower one. Stipules adnate only to the base of the petiole, villous, pectinate-laciniate. Flowers solitary or 2–3 terminal, 4–5 cm across. Pedicel short (3–10 mm). Bracts pectinate-laciniate, tomentose. Calyx lobes lanceolate, acuminate, entire, deciduous. Petals white. Styles free, slightly exserted. Fruit globose, ± 20 mm, tomentose.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa clinophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 66. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub with numerous stout hooked prickles. Leaflets (3–)5(–7), ovate, simple serrate, glabrous above, ± pubescent beneath. Stipules adnate to the petiole, sometime pectinate. Flowers double, corymbose. Pedicel slender, glandular-hispid like the calyx tube and base of the lobes. Petals blush to red. Styles little or not exserted. Fruit obovoid, 25 mm long, bristly, red.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa damascena. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 64. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sarmentose shrub with stout hooked prickles. Leaflets (5–)7–9, ovate-lanceolate, ± acuminate, sharply serrate, globrous or pubescent beneath on the nerves. Stipules adnate to the petiole except at the ends, entire or serrulate-glandular. Flowers few in corymbs, 3–4 cm across. Pedicel slender up to 3 cm, stipitate-glandular like the calyx tube and lobes. Calyx lobes lanceolate, narrow, sparingly pinnate, acuminate, deciduous. Petals white. Styles exserted, connate. Fruit ovoid up to 15 x 12 mm, scarlet.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa helenae. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 64. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large and stout climbing shrub up to 10 m. Flowers solitary, cream-white, fragrant, 10–15 cm across. Fruit globose or ovoid up to 15 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa odorata gigantea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 65. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sarmentose or climbing shrub with scattered prickles. Leaflets 5–7, elliptic-ovate, acuminate, sharply serrate, glabrous. Stipules adnate to the petiole, narrow, entire, ± glandular near the apex. Flowers 1–3, 5–8 cm across, very fragrant. Pedicel ± glandular. Calyx tube glabrous; lobes lanceolate subulate, entire, deciduous. Petals pink, white or yellow. Styles free, exserted. Fruit globose, red.
bibliographicCitation: Rosa odorata odorata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 65. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect or clambering shrub. Branches angled, yellow–tomentose, covered with curved prickles and sometimes glandular hairs. Leaves simple broad ovate or orbicular, obtusely 3–7-lobed, thick, 5–20 by 3–15 cm, usually deeply cordate, irregularly serrate, rugose above, tomentose underneath; nerves 5 pair, pubescent. Petiole 2–5 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, stipule segments capillary. Flowers 1.5–2 cm across, in axillary or contracted terminal panicles 18 cm long. Bract segments capillary. Pedicel 5–10 mm, reddish-setose. Calyx urceolate, fulvous-hairy; lobes lanceolate, tomentose. Petals obovate, white, glabrous, incised. Stamens numerous; anthers hairy at the apex. Carpels ca 30. Styles filiform, longer than the stamens; stigma flattened. Fruit globose, succulent. Stones rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus alceifolius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 55. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches terete, covered with hooked prickles. Leaves compound, palmate, 5-foliolate, upper ones simple or 3-foliolate, sparsely hairy. Leaflets sessile except the terminal one, elliptic, 4–9 by 2–4 cm, acuminate at the apex, doubly serrate; nerves 15–20 pairs. Petiole 1–5 cm long. Stiupoles joined to the petiole, persistent, filiform. Flowers up to 3 cm across, solitary or arranged in terminal panicles. Pedicel 2–3 cm, glandular. Bracts pinnatifid. Calyx pelviform, pubescent; lobes ovate, caudate, tomentose inside and on the margins, divided. Petals white. Stamens numerous. Carpels ca 12–15. Torus hirsute. Fruit globose, reddish. Stones rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus alpestris. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 52. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sarmentose shrub. Branches slender, tomentose, covered with small hooked prickles. Leaves simple, broad ovate or orbicular, distinctly and regularly 5–7-lobed, membranous, 10 by 6 cm, cordate at the base, serrate-mucronate, sparsely hairy, shining above; lobes rather acute, broad and short; nerves 8–10 pairs, hairy prominent on lower surface. Petiole 4 cm, tomentose, prickly. Stipules joined to the stem, divided, very caduceus. Flowers 8–10 mm across, in cylindric panicles. Pedicel stiff, 1 cm. Bracts oblong, incise-serrate, caducous. Calyx campanulate, white-tomentose; lobes ovate, acuminate. Petals orbicular, unguiculate, crenate. Stamens numerous; filaments flattened; anthers hairy at the apex. Carpels ca 20. Styles filiform, twice as long as the stamens; stigma sometimes bifid. Fruit reddish. Stones pitted.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus blepharoneurus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 59. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Sarmentose shrub or liana. Leaves compound plamate, 5-foliolate, younger sometimes 3-foliolate, densely grey-tomentose underneath. Leaflets lanceolate, 9–15 by 2–5 cm, serrate mucronate; nerves 9 paris. Petiole 5 cm, pubescent, prickly. Stipules joined to the stem, very caduceus, borad. Hairy. Flowers 5–8 mm across, in axillary or terminal panicles 3–10 cm long. Pedicel 3–8 mm, provided with 3 bracts. Calyx campanulate; lobes unequal, ovate, hairy, 3 external ones incised. Petals white, orbicular. Stamens numerous, shorter than petals; filaments glabrous; anthers hairy. Carpels ca 30–40. Styles filiform; stigma 2-lobed. Fruit globose, black at maturity.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus cochinchinensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 60. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Strong, scandent shrub. Branches terete, glabrous, covered with scattered, falcate prickles. Leaves simple, oblong-lanceolate, 18 by 8 cm, base cordate, apex acuminute, margins serrate, glabrous; nerves 7–8 pairs, prominent on the lower surface, veinlets forming a reticulate net. Petiole 1 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, linear, short, caducous. Flowers small (0.5 cm diam.), in large terminal panicles 12–18 cm long. Pedicel tomentose, 1–2 cm. Bracts linear, dentate, persistent. Calyx pelviform; lobes ovate-triangular, long mucronate, white-tomentose, on the margins. Petals reddish, shorter than the calyx lobes. Stamens numerous; filaments short, flattened. Carpels ca 30. Styles filiform, longer than the stamens. Fruit globose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus dielsianus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 53. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub clambering up to 12 m. Branches terete, glabrous or tomentose, covered with small, hooked prickles. Leaves simple, ovate, 15 by 7 cm, base cordate and ± lobed, apex acuminate, margins crenate, white-tomentose underneath;nerves 9 pairs, prominent on lower face, veinlets forming a prominent net. Petiole 3–5 cm, pubescent. Stipules joined to the stem, lanceolate, pinnate-incise, hairy, caduceus. Flowers 5 mm across, in terminal or axillary flexuous panicles, 20 cm long. Pedicel tomentose, erect. Bracts oblong, lanceolate, pubescent, serrate at the apex, caduceus. Calyx campanulate; lobes shortly mucronate, serrate on the margins. Petals orbicular, emarginate. Stamens numerous; filaments short, flattened. Carpels ca 10–20. Styles short. Fruit globose, dark reddish.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus elongatus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 53. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches terete and slender, covered with scattered, hooked prickles. Leaves simple, ovate, 3–5-lobed, 6–8 by 4–6 cm, coriaceous, broadly cordate at the base, acuminate at the apex, irregularly dentate, shining on upper surface, tomentose on the lower surface; basal nerves palmate, lateral ones 4–5 pairs. Petiole up to 7.5 cm long. Stipules joined to the stem, narrow (4 mm), pinnatifid towards the apex. Flowers 5 mm across, arranged in terminal or axillary panicles. Pedicel 8 mm. Bracts narrow, pinnatifid. Calyx urceolate, setose, tomentose; lobes entire or obscurely dentate. Petals elliptic dentate. Stamens numerous. Carpels ca 40. Styles filiform exserted. Fruit reddish. Stone rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus hasskarlii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 57. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches densely tomentose, covered with small, scattered, hooked prickles. Leaves simple, hastate, coriaceous, 12 by 5 cm, 4-lobed at the base, acuminate at the apex, serrate, glabrous above, yellow-tomentose underneath, terminal lobe lanceolate, basal lobes small and triangular; nerves 8 pairs, erect. Petiole 2 cm long. Stipules joined to the stem, stipule segments filiform. Flowers small (0.5 cm diam.), many-bracteate in axillary few-flowered panicles. Tomentose. Pedicel 2 cm, setose-prickly. Bracts lanceolate, pinnatilobed, caduceus. Calyx globose; lobes triangular, acuminate, serrate, tomentose. Petals white. Stamens longer than the styles. Carpels ca 12–20. Fruit globose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus hastifolius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 53. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches terete and slender, covered with dense long, reddish bristles and small declinate prickles. Leaves simple, broad ovate, palmatilobed, coriaceous, 9 by 9 cm, deeply cordate at the base, ciliate-serrulate, yellow-tomentose, distinctly veined underneath; lobes 3, short and broad; nerves 5 paris, prickly, setose. Petiole 4–8 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, palmatilobed, setose. Flowers 1.5 cm across in terminal and axillary cyindric panicles, 4 cm long. Calyx cylindric; lobes triangular, serrate at the apex. Petals white, lanceolate, unguiculate, crenate. Carpels ca 25–30, glabrous. Styles filiform, twice as long as the staments. Fruit globose. Stones rugose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus hederifolius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 60. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub climbing up to 20 m, glabrous, covered with strong hooked prickles, flattened at the base. Leaves compound pinnate, usually 3-foliolate, sometimes simple, coriaceous, glabrous and shining above. Leaflets broad ovate, 5–10 by 3–5 cm, acuminate at the apex, broadly and regularly dentate, midrib prickly; nerves 7 paris. Petiole 2–6 cm long, glabrous, prickly. Stipules joined to the petiole, linear. Flowers 10–15 mm across, in axillary few-flowered racemes or terminal panicles 4 cm long. Pedicel 5–12 mm, glabrous, unarmed. Bracts and bracteoles trifid, small caducous. Calyx globose, glabrous; lobe abruptly mucronate, grey-tomentose inside and on margins, persistent. Petals white, long-unguiculate. Stamens numerous, filaments flattence; anthers ovate. Carpels ca 80 on a prominent receptacle. Styles filiform, shorter than stamens. Fruit globose, reddish. Stones reniform.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus leucanthus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 49. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches densely fulvous-tomentose, covered with short, curved pricklis. Leaves simple broad ovate or orbicular, palmate, deeply and acutely 5–7 lobed, thin, 10 by 10 cm, cordate at the base, irregularly serrate, rugose and hairs above, tomentose underneath; nerves 5 pairs, prominent on lower surface. Petiole 2–5 cm, tomentose, prickly. Stipules joined to the stem, stipule segments capillary. Flowers 1 cm across, in terminal and axillary, contracted panicles 3 cm long. Pedicel 3–5 mm, reddish-setose. Bract segments linear. Calyx campanulate; exterior lobes incised. Stamens numerous; anthers hairy at the apex. Carpels ca 30–40. Styles longer than the stamens; stigma flattened. Fruit reddish, small.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus malvaceus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 56. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Clambering shrub. Branches grey-tomentose, covered with minute, hooked prickles. Leaves simple, palmatilobed, 12 by 10 cm, deeply and narrowly cordate, serrulate, reticulate-tomentose underneath, lobes 5, long, obtuse; nerves 7 pairs. Petiole 3–4 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, pinnatifid, segments lanceolate. Flowers 1.5 cm across, in terminal and axillary panicles 5–10 cm long. Pedicel 1 cm. Bracts ovate, incised. Calyx campanulate, hirsute; lobes acuminate incised. Petals unguiculate. Stamens numerous; filaments flattened; anthers hairy at the apex. Carpels ca 40. Styles filiform; stigma bilobed. Fruit red, globose.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus moluccanus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 57. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or liana. Branches stout, tomentose, covered with hooked prickles. Leaves simple, deeply 5-lobed, 9 by 9 cm, deeply cordate, serrate hairy above, tomentose-setose underneath, terminal lobe broad, truncate, lobulate; nerves 5 pair, arcuate, hirsute. Petiole 5 cm, aculeolate. Stipules joined to the stem, narrow, pinnatifid. Flowers 1.5 cm across, in terminal and axillary panicles 3–10 cm long. Pedicel 1.5 cm, provided with 3 bracts. Bracts broad incised at the apex. Calyx cylindric setose; lobes triangular, acuminate. Petals white. Stamens numerous; anthers hairy. Carpels ca 70. Styles filiform, longer than stamens; stigma lobed. Fruit reddish. Stones reniform wrinkled.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus multibracteatus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 56. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Erect or semi-scandent shrub. Branches glabrous sometimes pruinose, covered with scattered, hooked prickles. Leaves compound pinnate, 7–11-foliolate, variable in size, rather coriaceous, white-tomentose underneath. Leaflets 2–5 by 1–2 cm, often doubly dentate and mucronate, terminal one usually broad ovate and long-petiolulate. Lateral ones ovate, sessile; nerves 10 pairs, strong, straight, prominent underneath. Petiole 4 cm, pubescent grooved above, prickly underneath. Stipules joined to the petiole, lanceolate, Flower 1 cm across, in terminal many-flowered panicles 3 cm long. Pedicel 1 cm. Bracts and bractlets small, lanceolate, hairy. Calyx white-tomenthose; lobes triangular, mucronate. Petals deep pink, equalling the sepals, unguiculate. Stamens shorter than the petals; filaments compressed; anthers ovate orbicular. Carpels ca 50 borne on a rather flat receptacle. Styles filiform, short. Fruit globose, reddish. Stones pitted.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus niveus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 51. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches puberulent, provided with many straight and hooked prickles. Leaves compound, pinnate, 5–7-foliolate. Leaflets 2–4 by 1–2 cm, acute at the apex, dentate, sometimes incised, glabrous; nerves 8–10 paris. Petiole and rachis 10 cm long. Stipules joined to the petiole, linear. Flowers up to 5 cm across, arranged in 3-flowered cymes sometimes reduced to 1 flower. Pedicel 2–3 cm long. Calyx campanulate; lobes lanceolate, caudate, puberulent. Petals numerous, white, orbicular. Stamens very numerous; filaments filiform. Carpels ca 200, small on a prominent receptacle. Styles short. Fruit globose, reddish.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus rosifolius coronarius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 49. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub. Branches covered with dense long. reddish bristles and small declinate prickles. Leaves simple, palmatilobed. 14 by 17 cm, slightly cordate, serrate, haired above and fulvous-tomentose underneath; lobes 5, long and narrow; nerves 5 pairs, straight. Petiole 7–9 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, palmatifid, 1.5 cm wide. Flowers 1 cm across, in axillary and terminal panicles 3–7 cm long. Pedicel 0.5 cm. Bracts palmatifid, 2 cm wide. Calyx campanulate; lobes lanceolate, tomentose, setose. Petals white, unguiculate. Stamens numerous; filaments flattened. Carpels ca 30–40. Styles filiform, twice as long as the stamens; stigma lobed. Fruit reddish.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus rufus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 60. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Clambering shrub. Branches clothed with grey or yellow wool and curved prickles. Leaves simple, orbicular, palmate, distinctly and regularly 5-lobed, basal lobes broadly divergent. 10–18 cm wide, irregularly serrate, bullate on upper surface, clothed with grey wool underneath; lobes obtuse, terminal larger; nerves 5 pairs. Petiole 4–7 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, caducous, palmatifid, hairy. Flowers 12–18 mm across, in axillary clusters 4 cm long, or terminal panicles 10 cm long. Pedicel 2 mm. Bracts palmatifid, 1 cm wide, hairy. Calyx globose, reddish-tomentose; lobes lanceoate, reflexed. Petals white, incised at the apex. Carpels ca 40. Styles filiform, longer than the stamens; stigma 2-lobed. Fruit globose, reddish.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus rugosus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 58. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or liana. Branches terete, almost villous, covered with reddish stipitate gland and stout hooked prickles. Leaves compound pinnate, 7-foliolate, sometimes 1–3-foliolate in upper part, membranous, pubescent underneath. Leaflets lanceolate, acuminate, 2–7 by 1–2 cm, double incise-serrate; midrib prickly; nerves 5 pairs. Petiole 3–6 cm. Stipules joined to the petiole, 2–7 cm long, lanceolate, long-acuminate. Flowers in 3-flowered, sometimes 1–2-flowered cymes. Pedicel 2–3 cm, slender, villous prickly. Calyx pubescent outside; lobes ovate-lanceolate, long-pointed, pubescent-tomentose inside and on the margins, reflexed. Petals white, glabrous, unguiculate. Stamens numerous. Carpels ca 400, small, inserted on a prominent receptacle 1.5 cm high, conic, villous. Styles short, filiform; stigma flattened. Fruit reddish globose or more often oblong. Stones deeply pitted.
bibliographicCitation: Rubus sorbifolius. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 2. Part 1, 1970. Pg. 49. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climbing shrub. Branches tomentose-floccose, covered with small prickles. Leaves simple more or less orbicular, 6–12 by 5–9 cm, ± cordate at the base, acuminate at the apex, ± 3-lobed, dentate, tomentose on the lower face; nerves 6–8 paris. Petiole 3–4 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, pinnatifid. Flowers 1 cm across, arranged in pyramidal panicles up to 40 cm. Pedicel 1–2 cm. Bracts pinnatifid. Calyx pelviform; lobes lanceolate, caudate, tomentose. Stamens numerous; filaments as long as the styles. Carpels ca 10–20. Styles filiform. Fruit black at maturity. Stones rugose.

description: Clambering shrub. Branches covered with long, reddish bristles, stipitate glands and scattered, falcate prickles. Leaves simple, ovate, cordate, 3-lobed, 5 by 8 cm, dentate-mucronate, sparsely hairy on both sides; lobes angled, acuminate, the terminal one triangular; nerves 6 paris, hirsute. Petiole 5 cm. Stipules joined to the stem, divided, glandular, caducous. Flowers 1–1.5 cm across, arranged in contracted panicles 5–20 cm long. Pedicel 1 cm. Bracts filiform, caducous. Calyx urceolate; lobes lanceolate, dentate, tomentose inside. Petals white, small. Stamens numerous; filaments flattened. Carpels 15–20. Styles filiform, shorter than the stamens. Fruit yellowish. Stones rugose.

description: Tree. Twigs and young parts clothed with a flocculent cotton. Leaves ovate-lanceolate, 8–10 by 3–5 cm, base acute or broadly cuneate, apex acuminate, coarsely serrate, floccose when young, glabrous when old; nerves about 10 paris. Petiole slender, 2 cm long. Corymbs white-floccose when young, becoming glabrous and ± warted when fruiting. Pedicel 4–6 mm long. Calyx tomentose; lobes triangulae, acute, deciduous. Petals obovate, ± woolly within. Stamens about 20. Ovary 2–3-celled. Styles 2–3, connate below the middle, glabrous. Fruit rather pyriform, about 8 mm in diameter, not or sparsely spotted.

description: Shrub to 1.5 m. Leaves rhombic, 3–5.5 cm long, incised-serrate, glabrous. Petiole 6–8 mm long. Flowers about 1 cm across, in rather dense glabrous umbels. Petals white, suborbicular to oval, longer than stamens. Follicles with terminal spreading styles.

description: Treelet or tree. (2.5–)6–15(–20) m, trunk up to 20 cm diam. Bark brownish-greyish, smooth, shallowly fissured. Leaves oblong to subobovate-oblong, apex short-acuminate or obtusely apiculate, base cuneate, subcoriaceous to coriaceous, (6–)8–14 by (2–)2.5–4(–7) cm, nerves ca 15 pairs rather straight, a little prominent on both faces, or almost obscure beneath, reticulation faint; petiole 1–1.8 cm by 1–2 mm. Peduncle of umbel-like inflorescence 1–2 cm, with 3–5 branches each 2–10 mm long and bearing (3–)4–6 flowers crowded distally (flowers seemingly on top of peduncle when branches are very short). Calyx 2 mm. Petals white-yellowish to dull pink, (2.5–)3–4 mm. Drupe sobovoid-oblongoid, attenuate and sometimes a little curved distally, 4.5–5 by (1–)1.5–2.2 cm, pink or pale brown below, merging into pale green in the upper part.
